Bash(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8777/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer dummy" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{""""model"""":""""embeddings/dummy"""",""""input"""":""""Hello world""""}')

hooks.command: bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm\s+(-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f|-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*r)\b" && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm\s+-[a-zA-Z]+\s+\S*(node_modules|__pycache__|\.cache)"; then echo "BLOCKED: rm -rf is destructive. Use targeted removal." >&2; exit 1; fi'
bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE "DROP\s+(TABLE|DATABASE)"; then echo "BLOCKED: DROP TABLE/DATABASE is destructive (usage DB)." >&2; exit 1; fi'
bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git\s+push\s+--force.*(main|dev)"; then echo "BLOCKED: force push to main/dev." >&2; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "docker\s+compose\s+down\s+-v"; then echo "BLOCKED: docker compose down -v destroys the data/ volume (usage DB + model cache)." >&2; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git\s+commit"; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Review gate: if this change is M/L or a review-gate trigger fired (hot path, new module, user said done/push) - verify /review ran before committing; S-size quick fixes are exempt (workflow.md Phase 4).\"}"; fi'

bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git\s+commit" || exit 0; OUT=$(bash .claude/scripts/pre-commit-gates.sh 2>&1); [ $? -eq 0 ] && exit 0; echo "BLOCKED: pre-commit gates fail. Fix, then commit:" >&2; echo "$OUT" >&2; exit 1'

bash -c 'F="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; R=""; case "$F" in */tests/*) R="testing-ops.md";; */src/providers/*) R="providers.md testing-ops.md";; */src/services/*|*/src/api/*) R="services.md testing-ops.md";; */config/*|*config_manager.py) R="config.md";; *usage_db.py|*stat_page.py) R="stat.md";; esac; [ -z "$R" ] && exit 0; K=$(echo "$R" | tr -d " ."); M="/tmp/.router-rules-$K-${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-$(date +%j)}"; [ -f "$M" ] && exit 0; touch "$M"; echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Path-scoped rules apply - READ .claude/rules-scoped/: $R (reminder fires once per session).\"}"'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "git\s+commit" && [ "$CLAUDE_EXIT_CODE" = "0" ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Commit successful. Run /retro ONLY if a workflow.md Auto-lessons trigger fired this session (3+ fix iterations / production escape / new pattern / workflow optimization); otherwise skip.\"}"; fi'

bash -c 'F="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$F" in */plans/*.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$F" in */archive/*|*/superseded/*) exit 0;; esac; OUT=$(python3 .claude/scripts/plan-shape-gate.py "$F" 2>&1) && exit 0; echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Plan is OFF-SHAPE - /implement will refuse it. Rewrite (do not append):\n$(echo \"$OUT\" | tr -d \"\\\"\")\"}"'

bash -c 'echo "=== Git Status ==="; git status --short; echo; echo "=== Recent Commits ==="; git log --oneline -5; echo; echo "=== Docker ==="; docker compose ps --format "table {{.Name}}\t{{.Status}}" 2>/dev/null || echo "Docker not running"'

bash -c 'git fetch origin 2>/dev/null; BEHIND=$(git log HEAD..origin/dev --oneline 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$BEHIND" ]; then echo; echo "=== WARNING: dev is behind origin ==="; echo "$BEHIND"; echo "Run: git rebase origin/dev"; fi'
